name: @assayer/monorepo
description: Test enforcement + generation for TypeScript repos, maintained by LLMs.

scripts.build:clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/.ward/build.tsbuildinfo packages/@gateway/*/dist packages/@gateway/*/.ward/build.tsbuildinfo && npm run build
scripts.dev:stop: pkill -f '[d]esktop-main.js' || true; fuser -k 6273/tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait-on -r -t 5000 tcp:127.0.0.1:6273
scripts.dev: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/bin/assayer.js status && concurrently -k -n tsc-shared,tsc-core,tsc-desktop,tsc-cli,app,desktop -c gray,gray,gray,gray,blue,green "tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @assayer/app" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:6273 && npm run dev -w @assayer/desktop"
scripts.postinstall: if command -v pokayoke >/dev/null 2>&1; then pokayoke gateway-sync; fi
